entities.title: Language Course Visa Requirements
entities.summary: This page provides information on the requirements for a language course visa in Germany, including necessary documents and application process.
eligibility: Registration for an intensive German language course
required_documents: Registration for an intensive German language course
Proof of language courses done in Pakistan (if applicable)
Letter of motivation (only for Consulate General Karachi)
Documentation of school, college and academic degree and employment history
Income proof and bank statements of last 6 months of yourself or of your sponsor in Pakistan (only for Embassy Islamabad)
Information about any previous visa refusals
Information provided to applicants pursuant to Section 54 (2) 8 in conjunction with Section 53 of the Residence Act
Appointment confirmation e-mail (only for Embassy Islamabad)
application_process: Submit application form and required documents
important_notes: Please note that all copies of your documents have to be in DIN A4 size, complete and readable, and not stapled.
You have to arrange each set of documents according to the order in which they are mentioned below.
Please provide two sets of A4 size photocopies.
mandatory_prerequisites: Registration for an intensive German language course
